definitions.explanation: A rice dish made by cooking rice in seasoned broth with various ingredients. Often made with leftover rice and served as comfort food or to finish a hot pot meal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雑炊|ぞうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}りました→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made zosui after the hot pot meal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雑炊|ぞうすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べやすい→食べやすい：21799_tabeyasui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Zosui is easy to eat when you have a cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧{雑炊|ぞうすい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{雑炊|ぞうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ると→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can easily make a dish by using leftover rice to make zosui.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧{雑炊|ぞうすい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{締|し}め→締め：16134_shime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Zosui made with the richly flavored broth left after a hot pot is the perfect finishing dish.
examples.notes: ⟦{締|し}め→締め：16134_shime⟧ refers to the final dish to finish a meal

notes:
{雑炊|ぞうすい} is a Japanese rice porridge made by simmering rice in seasoned broth.

USAGE:
- Made with cooked rice, unlike ⟦{粥|かゆ}→粥：10316_kayu⟧/おかゆ, which starts from raw rice
- Uses flavorful broth such as dashi or leftover ⟦{鍋料理|なべりょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧ (hot pot) broth
- Rice keeps some texture, and egg is often swirled in at the end
- Common after hot pot, when sick, or as a late-night meal

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{粥|かゆ}→粥：10316_kayu⟧ / ⟦お{粥|かゆ}→お粥：16857_okayu⟧: rice porridge made from raw rice
